values: Connector-supplied source namespace. Immutable after creation. Together with External ID, identifies a source record uniquely. Human access: Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. Read only on receiving screens.

Imported from $.id. Immutable opaque source identifier. Together with Source System, forms the upsert key. Preserve source spelling and spaces. Human access: Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. Read only on receiving screens.

Imported from $.partNumber. Required and nonblank. Preserve identifier spelling. Not assumed globally unique. A changed number does not create a new source identity. Human access: Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. Read only on receiving screens.

Imported from $.partName. Initially null. Preserve source spaces, including trailing spaces. Explicit null clears the value. Human access: Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. Read only on receiving screens.

Imported from $.futurePartName. Initially null. Explicit null clears the value. Proposed text type and maximum length require confirmation against non-null producer data. Human access: Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. Read only on receiving screens.

Imported from $.lsPartNumber. Initially null. Explicit null clears the value. Proposed text type requires confirmation. No inferred relationship to another part. Human access: Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. Read only on receiving screens.

Imported from $.unitCost. Initially null. Proposed decimal precision 19, scale 6. Convert exactly without silent rounding. Confirm currency, unit basis, precision, and negative-value policy before business use. No minimum, maximum, or UoM is assumed. Human access: Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. Read only on receiving screens.

Imported from $.drawingNumber. Initially null. No automatic Drawing object lookup by name. A matching Product Family name does not merge identities. Human access: Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. Read only on receiving screens.

Imported from the Boolean $.status. No default. False prevents new manual component assignments while retaining the record and existing links. No external application effect. Human access: Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. Read only on receiving screens.

Stored display label imported from $.name. On creation only, use Part Number when name is absent or null. Explicit null on update is rejected. Not a formula or match key. Configure as the object display field separately. Human access: Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. Read only on receiving screens.

Imported from $.notes as plain Unicode long text. Initially null. Explicit null clears the value. Proposed maximum is 65,536 characters. Confirm non-null format and native capacity. Treat as plain text and escape when displayed. Human access: Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. Read only on receiving screens.

Imported from the Boolean $.includeAllFacilities. No default. Preserve the supplied true or false value. Does not grant permissions or create facility associations. Human access: Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. Read only on receiving screens.

Complete validated request document, including unknown properties and exact string contents. Retain as Unicode long text, with a proposed limit of 1 MiB UTF-8 per document. The template has no byte-limit setting, so Max Length is unset. Verify native capacity and binding before import; use native document storage if text cannot retain the full allowed document. Reject overflow before mutation. Refresh on every accepted receive and retain prior messages through native retention. Human access: Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. Read only on receiving screens.
